method: Enumerate each pinned revision through the Hugging Face model-tree API with recursive LFS expansion. Compare every safetensors path, LFS SHA-256 object ID, and byte count. Download and compare the small model.safetensors.index.json files separately.
conclusion: The bounded QSRT source revision and the published BF16-reference teacher revision contain byte-identical model-weight shards and byte-identical tensor indexes. Non-weight repository files differ between the revisions and are outside this weight-identity claim.
